title: 水平高、氛围好！2026北马诞生新纪录（中国新闻网）
claims: The 2026 Beijing Marathon ran jointly with the National Marathon Championships; more than 265,000 runners entered worldwide and the final field was 32,000.
Tola won in 2:03:10, breaking the Beijing record of 2:07:06 set by Kenyan Mathew Kisorio in 2019; the time is also the fastest marathon ever run in mainland China.
The 2026 mass-runner finish cut-off was shortened from the previous 6:15 to 6:00.
Championship men's podium: Chen Tianyu, Jiang Fakun, Xie Yunce; championship women's podium: Ciren Cuomu, Lu Ying, Xia Yuyu.

Medical cover comprised 26 fixed stations, 35 ambulances, 100 AED units, 610 medical observers and a 200 m² finish medical center; 160 rescue runners were assigned at a 1:200 ratio; 433 referees and 7,341 volunteers served.

Course services: eight drink stations, seven water/sponge stations and seven food stations; the organiser introduced a reusable environmental cup with multi-tap self-service drums and backpack water units.
